# The Prompt Director

Go from any idea to a finished scene — **without writing a single prompt yourself.**
You describe what you want; Claude writes the film-grade prompts for you. Two skills, one pipeline.

## Setup

1. Open this folder in **Claude Code** (as its own project).
2. Type `/image-prompter` to start.

That's it — nothing to install. The skills write **prompts**; you paste them into whatever image/video generator you use (Nano Banana Pro, GPT, Seedance, etc.).

## The pipeline

**Stage 1 — `/image-prompter`** *(build your assets)*
- Describe your model → **locked headshot + outfit**
- Generate a **6-panel character sheet** → every angle, full consistency
- Describe a scene → a **cinematic environment plate**

**Stage 2 — `/video-prompter`** *(bring it to life)*
- Drop in your sheet + plate, describe the moment
- Get your **Seedance video prompt**
- Paste it into your generator → **finished scene**

Every step, you just describe what you want — the Director writes the prompt.
